asset_uploads_completed_valid.name: asset_uploads_completed_valid
asset_uploads_completed_valid.value: "asset_uploads"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("asset_uploads"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_uploads"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

asset_uploads_failed_valid.name: asset_uploads_failed_valid
asset_uploads_failed_valid.value: "asset_uploads"."status" <> 'failed' OR ("asset_uploads"."error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_uploads"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL)

catalog_item_assets_has_source.name: catalog_item_assets_has_source
catalog_item_assets_has_source.value: "catalog_item_assets"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL OR "catalog_item_assets"."source_url" IS NOT NULL

reviews_decision_cause_consistent.name: reviews_decision_cause_consistent
reviews_decision_cause_consistent.value:
(
        "reviews"."decision" = 'adopted'
        AND "reviews"."reason" IS NULL
        AND "reviews"."quality_failure_cause" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "reviews"."decision" = 'not_adopted'
        AND length(trim(coalesce("reviews"."reason", ''))) > 0
        AND "reviews"."quality_failure_cause" IN ('technical', 'fidelity', 'spec_mismatch', 'preference_change', 'brief_change')
      )

shot_skill_validation_evidence_type_cons.name: shot_skill_validation_evidence_type_consistent
shot_skill_validation_evidence_type_cons.value:
(
        "shot_skill_validation_evidence"."evidence_type" = 'quality_gate'
        AND "shot_skill_validation_evidence"."review_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "shot_skill_validation_evidence"."evidence_type" IN ('adopted', 'rejected')
        AND "shot_skill_validation_evidence"."review_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

shot_skill_validation_evidence_reason_co.name: shot_skill_validation_evidence_reason_consistent
shot_skill_validation_evidence_reason_co.value:
("shot_skill_validation_evidence"."evidence_type" <> 'rejected' OR (
          length(trim(coalesce("shot_skill_validation_evidence"."reason", ''))) > 0
          AND "shot_skill_validation_evidence"."detail"->>'rejectionCause' IN ('technical', 'fidelity', 'spec_mismatch', 'preference_change', 'brief_change')
        ))
        AND ("shot_skill_validation_evidence"."evidence_type" <> 'adopted' OR "shot_skill_validation_evidence"."reason" IS NULL)

video_jobs_new_recipe_complete.name: video_jobs_new_recipe_complete
video_jobs_new_recipe_complete.value:
"video_jobs"."shot_skill_version_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "video_jobs"."shot_skill_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "video_jobs"."shot_skill_version" IS NOT NULL
        AND "video_jobs"."shot_skill_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "video_jobs"."recipe_snapshot" IS NOT NULL
